question_text: Construct total_fee(products) in Python. Each product has sold:Boolean and price:numeric. A marketplace charges 12% of the combined price of sold products only. Return the total fee; unsold products contribute nothing.
adaptation_rationale: Retains conditional object-list accumulation and percentage calculation; not map ped to object-instantiation.

marking_points.criterion: Uses the price of each sold product.
Returns total multiplied by 0.12 after the loop.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.

test_code:
from types import SimpleNamespace
ps=[SimpleNamespace(sold=True,price=100),SimpleNamespace(sold=False,price=900),SimpleNamespace(sold=True,price=200)]
